spec.kitLine: Deals 145.45% of final ATK as damage
spec.assertion: Structural: exactly ONE flatDamage block, trigger.kind 'interval', target 'enemy', atkPct===145.45, core!==true, flavor undefined. Behavioural: zeroing atkPct drops neve's total (>0 => live, non-vacuous) and doubling atkPct exactly doubles the delta (ratio 2.0 to 6dp). RED under: passive trigger (fires once at t=0), an invented event trigger, core:true over-credit, a sustained/sequential flavour tag, a fudged magnitude that doesn't track the kit %, or the rider being gated off entirely.
target.kind==='enemy' asserted; the lowest-HP selection itself it.skip'd — v1 has one immortal partless boss and no HP pool, so no fixture can discriminate the selection rule.
totals of every non-neve slug are byte-identical between the faithful run and the rider-zeroed run. RED if the rider were mis-targeted to allies or leaked into a shared bucket.

Count identity, order-independent: applies of the 124.8 atkPct buff === fullBurstStart count in controlComp('neve', true). The nearest-wrong (trigger patched to burstCast) fires strictly FEWER times (>0 but < FB count) because neve's 40s cd cannot cover every Full Burst in a two-Burst-III comp — which simultaneously proves the assertion discriminates and is not vacuous. RED if the driver keyed the block to burstCast (under-fires) or to a per-shot/interval trigger (over-fires).

buffApply stat 'atkPct' with RAW value 124.8 (a casterAtkPct mis-encoding would emit a flat ATK number, so the literal filter would find zero events), targetSlug always 'neve', and zero applications to any teammate. Zeroing it lowers neve's total and leaves all other slugs identical.

Structural: durationShots===2 and durationSec undefined; event-level: every buffApply carries durationShots===2. Behavioural: patching to durationSec:2 changes neve's total (a round window spans reloads and tracks fire rate, a 2s window does not). RED under the classic seconds mis-read, and RED under a stacks/until-reload/permanent encoding.

A gainPierce EFFECT exists on the fullBurstEnter/self block AND top-level hasPierce is not true. RED under the whole-fight boolean-flag model, which tags every shot of the 180s fight as Pierce instead of only the post-FB-entry rounds. Expiry after 2 ROUNDS is it.skip'd — gainPierce has only durationSec, no durationShots primitive, so any seconds value is a ⚑ estimate.

critRatePct-31.95 applies > 0 AND strictly < fullBurstStart count (a burstCast-keyed block cannot fire on every Full Burst at a 40s cd), and hitRatePct-22.04 applies === critRatePct applies (same cast). RED if either burst line were keyed to fullBurstEnter, which would over-credit her 20s crit/hit-rate window on rotations she never cast. This is the exact inverse of the skill2 assertion, so the two cannot both pass under a single mis-keying.

Structural: stat 'critRatePct' value 31.95, durationSec 20, durationShots undefined, and NO critRateNormalPct anywhere in the burst slot (the prose says plain 'Critical Rate ▲', so a normal-attack-scoped encoding would under-credit her skill1 rider). Event: self-only target, and its expiresFrame equals the Hit-Rate buff's (same cast, same 20s window — a frame-field-free duration-consistency check). Behavioural: zeroing it lowers neve's total, teammates unchanged.

Structural: stat 'hitRatePct' value 22.04, durationSec 20, self. Behavioural: zeroing it lowers neve's total — on a SG with a 200% core multiplier the hrCoreMult core lift is strictly damage-positive, so equality would mean the line is inert/dropped. The conversion magnitude itself is it.skip'd (ALWAYS-⚑ #7, measured-only).
No flatDamage / dot / storedHit / weaponSwap effect in the burst slot — the burst prose is two self-buff lines only, so any damage effect there is invented.

fixtures: PRIMARY controlComp('neve', true) — liter B1 + crown B2 so bursts actually chain (a lone Burst III makes ZERO Full Bursts), plus the fixed second Burst-III slot. That second B3 is load-bearing for the whole file: neve's 40s burst cd means she cannot cast on every Full Burst, so fullBurstEnter (== FB count) and burstCast (< FB count) separate by COUNT alone, with no dependence on intra-frame event ordering between fullBurstStart and buff dispatch. SECONDARY controlComp('neve', false) (neve sole B3) used only as a liveness/non-vacuity check that the fixture family bursts at all. 9 hoisted runs total (base, sole, rider-zero, rider-double, skill2-as-burstCast, atk-as-seconds, atk-zero, crit-zero, hitrate-zero); all counterfactuals via withPatchedOverride clones, committed JSON untouched. Structural checks tolerate both the bare Block[] slot shape and a slot-object-with-blocks[] shape so they can't false-RED on container shape.
gaps: skill1 interval cadence + first-fire phase — it.skip: the kit text gives the damage line NO activation clause, so the seconds value is outside a blind read's input domain (ALWAYS-⚑ #2); pin from the datamined skill cooldown or popup footage.
skill1 'lowest remaining HP' enemy selection — it.skip: single immortal partless boss with no HP pool, selection rule unobservable in v1.

skill2 'Gain Pierce for 2 round(s)' expiry — it.skip: gainPierce carries only durationSec; there is no round-count (durationShots) primitive for it, so the round window cannot be expressed faithfully and any seconds value is a ⚑ estimate.

skill2 Pierce damage contribution — it.skip: the control comp carries no Pierce Damage ▲ consumer, so the pierce tag moves no damage; only structural (gainPierce effect present, hasPierce flag absent) is testable here.
burst Hit-Rate → core-rate conversion magnitude — it.skip: engine-side hrCoreMult is measured-only (ALWAYS-⚑ #7); only the direction of the 22.04% grant is assertable from prose.
notes: No file writes were possible — this role was dispatched with NO tools available, so scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/neve.test.ts and neve.test-spec.json were NOT written to disk; the full test source and spec are returned inline above for the orchestrator to persist at those paths.
